effect.name: Cut-Off Alpha Test (Texture)
effect.description: The shader checks the alpha value; if it is greater than 0, it sets it to 1; otherwise, it sets it to 0. Additionally, it multiplies the RGB colors by the original alpha value.
effect.author: Foxioo
